dialogOption.texten: 911, what's your emergency?
Hello? Umm... there's a strange car at the back of our building...
{ADDRESS?}Could you give me the address, sir?
Yes, we're at [[ADDRESS]]
its 345 Oxygen Road
its 124 2nd Avenue
its 504 Basic Square
{WHICH BUILDING?}Is this a residence or a business?
It's an insurance company office building.
It's an office of a mining company.
It's a labor union office.
{PROHIBITED AREA?}Is that car parked in prohibited area?
It's private property.
{WHO ARE YOU?}Who am I speaking to?
I'm Jason Sobers, security guard.
{WHO PARKED THE CAR?}Did you see who parked it there?
That's the thing, nobody saw it being parked and it's not supposed to be there, it's a restricted area.
{ANY CAMERAS?}Are there any surveillance cameras in the area?
Yeah, we do, but the car is parked exactly in the blind spot!
{STAY AWAY FROM THE CAR}Sir, tell everyone to stay away from the area.
Well, ok... do you think it's that important?
{EVACUATE THE BUILDING}You should start to evacuate the building immediately! Sound the fire alarm now!
{NOT SURE}No sir, maybe not. Please keep calm, the situation is under control.
Oh my god... do you think it's one of those bombs?! Should I tell people?
{YES}Yes, tell everyone and evacuate as fast as possible!
{NO}No, just pull the fire alarm and make sure everyone gets to a safe place.

dialogOption.emotions: really scared! Alarm ring soon after
dialogOption.texten: OH MY GOD!!! Of course! . . . . . . . . . . . . . . EVERYONE, GET OUT OF HERE NOW, THERE'S A BOMB!..... RUN!.....
Oh my.... of course.... the alarm . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . what now?
{GO TO SAFE ZONE AND WAIT}There is nothing more for you to do right now, just get out of the building, wait in the safe zone for the emergency services to arrive. They will be there shortly.
What should I do then?
{JUST WAIT}Just wait for the services to arrive.
Ok, I will wait...
{DID YOU CHECK CAR?}Did you check that car?
Not yet. I thought it might be dangerous. There's all kinds of stories about bombs going off in the news. I thought I'd call 911 first.
{CHECK THE CAR} Go out and check the car closely.
Ok, I'm going . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . What should I check?
Just look through the windows and under the car.

dialogOption.emotions: unsure at first, disbelief and shocked at the end
dialogOption.texten: Ok... Hmmm . . . . . I don't see anything under the car . . . . . . . . I'm looking in the windows . . . . . . Oh, sweet Jesus . . . Is that a bomb?
{WHAT DO YOU SEE?}What do you see?
There is... there's a device with a lot of cables and wires. It's attached to... some kind of a container. God, what should I do?!
{GO BACK!}Go back to the building immediately!

dialogOption.emotions: running, problem with catching his breath [sound of opening door]
dialogOption.texten: Yes... I'm going back . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . I'm inside!
{IT'S NOT IMPORTANT} We have no time for that now, sir. Please contact the security of the building.
But I am security!
{IT'S YOUR JOB}So... aren't you paid to deal with such problems?
Well... yes, but I-I... Nevermind. I'll find somebody who will treat me seriously. Bye.
Ok, I'm going! Thank you!
I really think that might be dangerous!

reportElement.texten: The caller reported an unknown car in a restricted area.
The caller notified the people about a bomb, causing panic, which resulted in a person being injured.
The operator told the security guard to wait for emergency services.
The operator instructed to evacuate the building.
Operator's instructions put the caller in danger. Checking the car could cause detonation of the bomb.
Operator ignored a serious terrorist threat.
